ImageDescription.value:
Fresco Still Life and Blossoming Almond Trees.

Commissioned by civic-minded philanthropist Rosalie Meyer Stern. The mural, painted in 1931, depicts Stern’s grandchildren in the foreground.

It is now located in the Stern Hall women’s dormitory at the University of California, Berkeley.
